findings.description: Entitlements for the long-stalled 15-story, 770,000 sq ft office project were extended 18 months by the Planning Commission; developer BXP still needs an anchor tenant to finance construction.

citation.label: SFist, “Long-Stalled 15-Story High-Rise at Fourth and Harrison Advances In SF’s SoMa,” 29 September 2026
